title: Growing Momentum for Cooperatives and the Social and Solidarity Economy
desc: A new United Nations report highlights growing global recognition of the social and solidarity economy and the important role of cooperatives in advancing sustainable development, decent work and social justice.The report of the Secretary-General, “Promoting the social and solidarity economy for sustainable development” (A/81/288), finds that the sector has received greater legal, policy and institutional attention in recent years, although progress in translating commitments into effective implementation and sustained results remains uneven.

title: Doping strategy of BSe/WSe2 heterostructures to realize the adsorption and sensing of harmful NH3 and NO2 gas molecules: a density functional theory study
desc: In the present study, density functional theory calculations were used to examine different stacking configurations of BSe/WSe2 van der Waals heterostructures. Then, the binding of noble metals (Ag, Au, Pd and Pt) on the surface of heterostructures was investigated. Adsorption behaviors of NH3 and NO2 molecules on the considered Ag modified BSe/WSe2 heterostructures was also explored. The lattice mismatch rate is calculated to be 1.22%, which is lower than the threshold value, indicating the feasibility of BSe/WSe2 heterostructure formation. The binding energy of Ag atom on the hollow site of BSe/WSe2 substrate is determined to be -1.35 eV, implying the stability of Ag modified material for gas adsorption. However, the highest binding strength belongs to the Pt adsorption on the hollow position with significant binding energy of -2.25 eV. The band structures, charge density difference, recovery time and work functions were also analyzed for the adsorption systems. Both NH3 and NO2 molecules are chemisorbed on the Ag modified BSe/WSe2 heterostructure. Among the adsorption configurations, NO2 adsorption by double O atoms exhibits the large adsorption energy of -2.04 eV, revealing the strong interaction between gas molecule and substrate. The results suggest that the Ag modified BSe/WSe2 heterostructure has a great potential for application as effective gas sensor.
